headline: Meta and Roblox Agree to Strengthen Child-Safety Measures in the Philippines
seoTitle: Meta, Roblox Strengthen Child Safety in Philippines | FMB News
seoDescription: Meta and Roblox agreed to stronger child-safety protections in the Philippines, including age verification, parental controls and faster removal of harmful content.
deck: The platforms committed to stronger age checks, parental controls, faster harmful-content removal and closer cooperation with Philippine authorities.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Meta and Roblox agreed to strengthen child-safety protections for users in the Philippines following discussions with Philippine officials, according to Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda.
The commitments include stronger age-verification systems, improved parental controls, quicker removal of harmful content and increased cooperation with law-enforcement authorities.

sections.heading: Platform commitments
paragraphs: Roblox is expected to establish a Philippine office by October, while Meta plans to send a team to work on a timeline for expanding its local presence, according to Reuters.
Both companies also signaled willingness to work with lawmakers as Congress considers tighter rules governing minors' access to social-media and online platforms.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The agreement comes amid heightened concern over child exploitation, online threats and livestreamed violence. Philippine authorities have been pressing major platforms for faster response mechanisms and more effective safeguards for younger users.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Age assurance, parental controls and rapid moderation can reduce exposure to harmful material, but implementation details, privacy protections and enforcement standards will determine whether the commitments produce meaningful safety improvements.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: DICT and other Philippine agencies are expected to work with the companies on implementation timelines while Congress continues debating broader online-safety legislation for minors.

sources.title: Meta, Roblox agree to child-safety measures sought by Philippines, minister says
